methodology: Five alternating trials per evaluator/implementation. No other task builds or tests ran concurrently. Wall times use Python time.monotonic.

Evaluation forces drvPath and the full fetch dependency graph. Every evaluator/case is warmed once. No IFD or builds; OS page cache and iets compiled-file cache remain warm. iets tracing-cache reuse and fallback to Nix are disabled.

Direct assembly uses identical realized archives and project sources, fresh output directories, NIX_BUILD_CORES=4 and DRVJS_JOBS=4. Excludes export, evaluation, downloads, NAR registration and cleanup.

The default comparison uses the previous pnpm default and the new native default. The native comparison explicitly passes --native to the old binary; the core native assembler has essentially unchanged speed.

Nix rebuilds warm both inputs first, then time nix-build --check with --max-jobs 4 --cores 4. Includes evaluation, assembly, daemon and NAR-check overhead; excludes export, downloads, helper compilation. Both outputs pass every reproducibility check.

Closure counts include required input outputs and their runtime closures, the selected project and archives. Excludes the compiler used to build drvjs. Compressed bytes are sums of FileSize from a fresh local Nix binary cache using zstd level 3; no remote latency measurement.
No package contents were pruned. Installed output size is essentially unchanged. All 741 full-workspace fixed-output archive paths match the baseline.
The full Vue workspace was evaluated but not installed; assembly and closure measurements use the compiler-sfc subset. ARM64 was not tested.

iets_checks: matching drvPaths with 1 and 4 workers on fixture/subset/full exports
